# Estonia — notes

- Main source: Statistics Estonia table JS009 (recorded offences by county and degree/type, 2006–2021), rows "..manslaughter" (§113) and "..murder" (§114) kept separately, plus "Offences total". Table sits in the "Discontinued tables" archive — Statistics Estonia stopped it after 2021; no newer county table exists in the database. 2017 is blank for every county row (only 3 national cells filled) in the source itself.
- JS02 (2002–2007) gives a combined "Manslaughter, murder" line by county; overlaps JS009 for 2006–2007 (figures may differ slightly as JS02 is "recorded by the police" and JS009 "recorded offences" incl. prosecutor-registered).
- Ministry of Justice crime-statistics portal (statistika.justdigi.ee) publishes §113/§114 counts nationally only (2016–2025); its county CSV has no homicide line. Kept as national rows for continuity after 2021.
- Areas: 15 counties + Tallinn (shown as a sub-row of Harju county) + "No distribution by county".
- Licence: andmed.stat.ee footer states "Statistics Estonia's open data can be shared under Creative Commons (CC) licence BY-SA 4.0". justdigi.ee states no licence.
- Not tried: Estonian health statistics (TAI) deaths by assault by county — would be an alternative post-2021 sub-national measure.
